title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.46: When Pass the Mic or Duet is auto-played by an ordered resolver (Workshop, Showtime, Da Capo, Spectacle), you now pick which ally to target via the normal targeting reticle, synced across clients. Remix (and the Intermission turn-end auto-play) still pick a random ally. No prompt appears with only one ally, so 2-player co-op is unchanged.
